dmag mi'i bsam pa la mi de'i chas nom pa gang yod len rgyu yod bsam pa dang*/ yang de las cher dga' tshor che bar/ dper na tshong pa stobs chen zhig byung na de dag rnams kyi nom pa ji snyed thob bo bsam pa'i dga' tshor chen po 'byung ba/ dpe de bzhin du rnam rtog che chung gang skyes kyang de mi spang ba sgom du khyer ba yin/ rnam rtog kho rang la sgom pa yin/ dug lnga'i rnam rtog gang shar sgom du khyer nas de'i rang ngo la bltas pas gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog de dag nas ye shes lngar grol ba yin/ de yang las dang po pa gang zag gsar bu bas rnam rtog bkag pa yin/ lam zhugs dus rnam rtog mi bkag /rnam rtog skyon du mi lta bar bsgom pas mthar rnam rtog de zad nas rang rig gi chos sku de rtogs pa yin/ dpe ji ltar na me chas zin pa'i spra ba'i me de la rlung phog na da lta nyid du dag nas me de shi 'gro/ nags tshal chen po la me 'bar na de la rlung chen po byung na me'i grogs su gyur nas me de ches cher 'bar ba yin/ dpe des mtshon pas las dang po pas rnam rtog bkag /de nas lam zhugs dus rnam rtog ma bkag pas rnam rtog kho rang sgom gyi grogs su 'gyur ba shes par byas nas bsgom rgyu yin gsungs/ ka dag 'di nyid khregs gcod kyi ngo bor gsor du 'jug pa la/ sems mi gnas pa gnas par byed pa nyan thos zhi ba'i lta stangs/ gnas pa brtan par byed pa byang chub sems dpa'i lta stangs/ brtan pa thob nas grol bar byed pa khro bo'i lta stangs te gong ma gnyis song nas khro bo nyid kyi lta stangs la// lus gnad bca'/ rlung ro 'bud/ sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor la yang dag par 'bad/ de nas mnyam bzhag gi sems 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa bdag 'dzin dang bral ba gser bslad thon pa'i lhing ma'i 'od lhang nge'am dngul spur dag pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bu dang khyil ler ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag

/mig nam mkhar 'bur tshugs su lta/ de'i ngang la ma yengs pa har re langs nas gom pa gya tshoms su 'dor zhing lag pa sdigs mdzub bsgrengs ba dang bcas te/ ha ha/ hi hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de ltar byas/ mnyam bzhag tu bsdad pa'i sems dang*/ langs nas lta gdengs ha hi brjod pa'i skabs gnyis/ ka dag gi ngo bor gnas lugs gcig gam tha dad 'dug lta/ tha dad byung na gong gi sngon 'gro rnams la gnad du ma non lam du ma 'byongs pa yin/ gcig na lam 'byong ba yin/ yang sngar ltar mnyam par bzhag /dug lnga'i rnam rtog las dper na zhe sdang lta bu zhig shar tshe de spang kyang mi spang*/ rjes mthud kyis bsgrub kyang mi bsgrub par zhe sdang lhang nger shar ba de kha'i rang ngo la blta ba dang phaṭa drag po brjod pa dang sbrags/ har re langs nas khro bo'i gad mo dang*/ lta stangs mchongs rgyug sogs byed/ 'gro sdod la khyad med pa'i zhe sdang rang sar dag na 'byong ba yin/ dpe de lta bu/ 'dod chags/ gti mug /nga rgyal/ phrag dog thams cad la 'gre/ dug lnga'i rtog pa gang byung yang so sor dran pas slebs pa'i sor chud na/ rtogs pa skye/ slob ma 'du ba/ gdul bya rgyas pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du ba/ dgra bgegs sgrol ba sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung*/ de lta bu ched du bsgom pa ni a cang yang che ste/ dus rgyun du sdod pa/ 'gro ba/ za 'thung sogs sgo gsum gyi bya byed ci dang gang byed kyang gong bzhin dran pas slebs pa dang*/ de thams cad la sems so sor med pa gcig tu rtogs pa e 'dug yang yang zhib dpyad byed/ de dag thams cad rang sa rang ngos zin cing so sor tha dad du ma gyur na lam ma nor bar brtan pa thob pa yin no// 'di yan ni rdzogs chen rang skad kyi sngon 'gro yin/ chos gzhan gyi ni nyams len mthil thug pa yang dag pa yin no// 'di yan rdzogs pa chen po'i sngon 'gro thun mong dang*/

thun mong ma yin pa rnams legs par grub bo/ ༈ /dngos gzhi khregs chod kyi lam gnas lugs ka dag spros bral du ston pa dang*/ thod rgal lhun grub ye shes mngon sum ston pa gnyis te/ 'di man shin tu las kyang ches gsang ba rdzogs pa chen po'i rang skad yin pas/ brgyud pa 'dzin nges shes pa'i slob ma ma gtogs gzhan la mi shod/ gzhan la shod dus shad khrid tsam ma gtogs zhib sel ba'i srol med do gsungs pas gsang rgya yod/ dang po khregs chod zhes pa gzhi a 'thas sra zhing mkhreg pa 'di dag stong pa nyid kyis chod dgos pa'i don yin pas/ sems gnas na gnas 'dug bsam mkhan dang*/ gnas mkhan gnyis byung bas de gcig gam so so tha dad yin/ dpe de bzhin du/ 'gyu ba dang*/ 'gyu ba ngos zin mkhan/ sgom byed pa dang*/ bsgom byed yod bsam mkhan/ lha sgom pa po dang sgom mkhan de dag thams cad so sor yin nam gcig tu yin/ thams cad stong pa yin na lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas dge sdig spyod rgyu 'dug /gzugs su grub pa zhig yin na stong pa zer ba kho rang yang stong rgyu zhig dgos/ de yang lus kyi byed las/ ngag gi byed las/ sems kyi sems las thams cad gcig gam tha dad/ stong ngam mi stong*/ stong na bde sdug thams cad sems kyis myong dgos 'dug /ro la bde sdug mi 'byung*/ mi stong na sra zhing 'thas pa'i lus kyang 'ja' lus yal rgyu 'dug /de ltar lus ngag yid gsum la dpyad 'jug zhib tu byed/ gang la'ang ngos bzung med pa zhig shar tshe de la phur tshugs su bsgom gsungs/ 'di yan rtog pa rtsad gcod lugs yin/ sems kyi mtshang btsal ba la dmigs rkang gsum ste/ dang po sems 'dis lha sa lta bu zhig wal te shar du bcug /de rang sems me long lta bu la tshur shar ba yin nam/ sems kho rang phar slebs pa yin nam/ slebs pa yin na lha sa'i bya byed thams cad kyang shes dgos te/ slar dpyad zhib byas na ma gtogs mi 'byung*/

tshur shar ba yin na shar ba'i yul zhig dgos byung bas na rtsad bcad/ de yan dmigs rkang gcig yin/ yang dper na mdun du nas kyi phung po zhig yod na/ de sems kyis mthong ngam/ mig gis mthong*/ sems kyis mthong na nas kyi phung po 'dug snyam pa las grangs su mi thebs pa yin kyang*/ de dpyad gzhig ma byas par dang po mthong dus de nas grangs su thebs pa zhig dgos mod/ de bzhin du mi mang po dang*/ nags tshal chen po mthong ba yang gong dang mtshungs/ dmigs rkang gnyis/ yang dril bu zhig bkrol na de lus kyis bkrol lam sems kyis bkrol/ lus kyis bkrol dus skad thams cad kyis thos pa yod kyi/ sems kyis bkrol dus kyang skad thos rgyu yod dgos byung*/ de skad thos rgyu yod min dpyad zhib ma byas par mi shes/ de ltar zhib mor dpyad pa ni dmigs rkang gsum pa'o/ (1) /da sems byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pa la/ 'di lan gnyis byung ba ni/ snga ma ni yul la brtag pa yin la/ 'di ni yul yul can la brtag pa yin/ de yang brtag lugs ji ltar brtag na bla ma'i mos gus kyis sems bzung*/ lus rnam snang chos bdun byas la/ dper na dgra lta bu zhig mig gis mthong nas zhe sdang gi sems rtog wal gyis shar byung na/ zhe sdang de rang las byung ngam pha rol dgra las byung*/ rang las byung na snying mig rna ba ste tshogs drug gang las byung*/ gzugs dang kha dog ji ltar 'dug /pha rol dgra las byung na dgra de'i phyi nang mgo mjug gang las byung*/ gzugs kha dog ji ltar 'dug zhib tu dpyad nas brtag dpe des rigs 'gre bas/ 'dod chags/ nga rgyal/ phrag dog /gti mug snying rje/ dad pa/ mos gus thams cad la brtag nas sems de gar lta/ de yan dmigs rkang le tshan gcig byed/ 'o na sems de ga rang las byung na/ de gnas sa zhig med pa'i thabs med pas mgo mjug tshogs drug gang la gnas/ phyi'i dgra la gnas na dgra de'i lus mgo mjug phyi nang gang du gnas/

gnas dus 'dug tshul sogs ji ltar byas nas sdod 'dug /des rigs 'gre bas/ 'dod chags/ nga rgyal/ phrag dog /gti mug /snying rje/ dad pa/ mos gus thams cad la brtag nas sems de gnas tshul ga 'dra 'dug blta/ 'dis dmigs rkang gcig byed/ yang 'gro sa la brtag dus sems zhe sdang lang nas 'gro dus rang gi dbang po'i sgo nang nas 'gro/ rkang tshugs nas 'gro 'am/ 'phur nas 'gro/ 'gro sa gar 'gro/ sdod sa gar sdod/ phyi rol dgra las tshur byung na 'ong lugs ji ltar byas nas 'ong*/ 'ong nas gar sdod/ yang gar 'gro bcas/ des rigs 'gre bas dug lnga dang dad pa snying rje mos gus gsum sogs la'ang dpyad nas 'gro yul la blta'o// da ngo sprod kyi sngon 'gro la/ gzhung bzhin las bla ma la maṇ+ḍal lan gsum 'bul rjes bla ma brgyud pa'i bla ma'i byin 'bebs gnang*/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rim par gcig la gcig thim nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la bsdu/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sku bum pa/ gsung gsang ba/ thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ de nas bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang gi snying khar thim pas rang sems dang bla ma'i thugs bsres nas des rang ngo la ci gnas mnyam par 'jog /yang mdun gyi thad khru gang tsam gyi sa la mig gtad de/ 'dzin rtog med par ha rer bzhag /yang mig bar snang la 'dom gang tsam gyi dkyil du ha rer gtad la der 'dzin med par 'jog /yang rang sems bla mar tshur gtad nas der 'dzin blos bcas bcos med par cham mer 'jog /de ltar tshar gsum byed do// dngos gzhi gnas lugs lta thog nas ngo sprod la sa bcad bdun las/ dang po rnam rtog sems su ngo sprod pa ni/ rnam rtog kyang sems yin la/ rnam rtog las gzhan pa'i sems med de/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po chu rlabs dang bcas pa ste/ rgya mtsho yang chu yin la rlabs kyang chu las ma 'das te/ rba rlabs de dag byung yang chu las byung*/

thim yang chu rang la thim/ de gnyis 'byed du mi gtub/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nas chu bo ji snyed grangs las 'das pa 'bab pa'ang*/ rgya mtshor thams cad ro gcig pa'o// gnyis pa sems stong par ngo sprod pa la/ stong pa la bem stong dang rig stong gnyis yod pas/ bem stong ni nam mkha' stong pa/ rdza ma stong pa/ phad bu stong pa ste/ de dag gi stong rgyu dang rig rgyu dang*/ gsal rgyu dang*/ yang stong rgyu sogs med pas bem stong yin/ sems stong pa la sna tshogs 'char rgyu yod/ gsal rgyu yod/ myong rgyu yod/ rig rgyu yod/ de dag thams cad stong gsal bdag med 'gro rgyu yod/ bem stong la stong rkyang las ngo bo med pa'o// gsum pa stong pa snang bar ngo sprad pa la/ stong pa'i ngang las snang ba rnam rtog sna tshogs su shar ba de'i rang ngo la bltas pas 'di zhes mtshon du med pa stong nyid de ka'i ngo bor 'gro/ slar yang 'char sgo ji ltar snang ba thams cad kyang cir yang snang ba ste brjod du med pa'i ngo bo stong nyid kho rang las byung pa'o// bzhi pa snang stong gnyis med du ngo sprod pa la/ snang dus na stong pa med la/ stong dus na snang ba med pa de ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dus gnas pa ste/ rgyu med na 'bras bu mi 'byung bas/ des na rig ma rig gi khyad par yin la/ rig dus na/ stong pa las snang ba 'byung*/ snang ba stong par grol bas na snang stong med pa'o// lnga pa gnyis med rang grol du ngo sprod pa la/ snang stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo de ni/ ye gdod ma nas sems nyid kyi ngo bo chos sku/ de'i rang rtsal las 'phro 'du sna tshogs su 'char ba ni sprul sku 'char ba'i yul dang 'char gzhi gnyis so so tha dad ma yin pa zung 'jug tu gnas pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste sku gsum rang thog tu gnas pa'o// drug pa dug lnga rang grol du ngo sprod pa la/ dper na mdun du dgra gcig cer re byung na de la zhe sdang drag pos gri phyung ste gsod pa'i bsam pa skyes pa de zhe sdang ngo thog kho rang yin/

da mi 'di bsad na mi yang sdig che bsam pa de mdo lugs ltar zhe sdang spangs pa yin yang dgra de la snying rje tshad med pa skyes nas lan mi byed pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yin/ zhe sdang drag po cu hril hril shar dus spang kyang mi spang*/ bsgyur yang mi bsgyur/ rjes su yang mi 'brang bar zhe sdang de kha'i rang ngo la gcer gyis bltas pas 'di zhes mtshon du med pa rig pa rang gsal gyi ngang du grol ba ni me long ye shes te/ zhe sdang dang me long ye shes ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul yang yin/ dper na shing la me 'bar ba dang 'dra ste/ shing gis bsreg pa yang mi nus/ tsha ba'i ngad kyang med/ me la shing med par me 'bar rgyu yang med/ shing la sdong po yal ga me tog 'bras bu 'byung gi/ me la de bzhin tsha ba'i ngad dang bsreg pa'i nus pa yod kyi shing med par me mi 'byung bas/ dper na zhe sdang ni shing lta bu/ me ni me long ye shes lta bu yin no// dpe des mtshon pa'i/ nga rgyal/ 'dod chags/ gti mug /phrag dog sogs la rigs 'gre bas dug lnga ma spang ye shes lnga ru grol ba de'o// de bzhin rtsa nyon nye nyon nyi shu sogs mi dge ba'i rtog pa thams cad rang shar rang grol du shes dgos pa'o// bdun pa tshogs drug rang grol du ngo sprod pa ni/ mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes mi mdzes/ rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan mi snyan/ sna yi yul du dri zhim mi zhim/ lce yi yul du ro mngar mi mngar/ lus kyi reg bya 'jam rtsub ste de dag thams cad tshor ba yod pa la 'dzin pa med pa ste/ dper na bu chung gi lha khang mthong ba lta bu dgos/ de ji ltar mthong na/ bu chung zhig lha khang khra mo zhig gi nang du slebs tshe/ bu chung des mig gis thams cad ni mthong*/ ltad mo ni che ste/ don la lha 'di zhi ba red/ 'di khro bo red/ 'di bla ma red/ 'di byang sems red bsam pa'i rtog pa med/ de bzhin du 'di mtshal red/

mthing red/ ba bla red/ gser red/ dngul red bsam pa'i rtog pa gang yang med par khra cha ler mthong ba lta bu ste/ tshogs drug gi dus su zhen 'dzin gyi rjes su ma 'brang bar rang ngo blta ba'o// nyams myong sgom thog nas ngo sprod pa la/ dang po bsam gtan rang ngo la ngo sprod pa/ ri bo cog bzhag ces slob bu rnams lus rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos bdun gyis lus mi g.yo bar 'ching du bcug /rgya mtsho cog bzhag ces sems dus gsum gyi rnam rtog gang gis kyang ma bslad/ da lta'i shes pa gsal hrig ger 'dzin med kyi ngang las 'da' ba med par 'jog tu bcug /de ni dri ma med pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa de rang rig chos sku 'gyur med gsal le sing nge wal le/ yang khrol le/ sprin med ston ka'i nam mkha'i rang bzhin can de ka dag khregs chod kyi gnas lugs yang dag pa'o// zhes ngo sprod/ sems gsal dwangs de kha ma yengs pa'i ngang nas phaṭa drag po zhig brjod du bcug /de brjod pa'i rkyen gyis mi rtog pa'i ngang de zhig kyang rtog pa der 'dzin med pa phyal le ba zhig 'char yang de'i rang ngo nas phaṭa cig brjod du bcug la de'i rang ngo de 'dzin med bsam gtan gyi rang ngo yin par ngo sprod/ gnas pa gcig pos 'tshang mi rgya ste/ des 'tshang rgya na bsam gtan sgom pa'i lha gnas thams cad sangs rgyas tshar/ des sangs mi rgya de mthar lhung rgyu yod/ de bzhin du 'gyu ba gcig pos sangs mi rgya ste rigs drug gi sems can thams cad 'gyu ba sha dag yin pas sangs rgya rgyu med/ rig pa gcig pos sangs mi rgya ste/ dmyal ba'i sems can rnams kyis na ba yang rig /tsha ba yang rig /des na gnas 'gyu rig gsum po de 'dzin med blo 'das kyi ngang la ngos zin pa zhig dgos/ de ngos zin phan chad shes pa gnas 'gyu bzang ngan gyi rtog pa gang lta bu zhig shar yang rang ngo la cer gyis bltas pas 'dzin med rang gnas kyi bsam gtan 'char te rtsol med lhun grub kyi sgom pa chu bo lta bu la brtan pa thob dgos te/

de thob phyin chad tshogs drug gi snang ba ji ltar shar yang sgom pa chu bo dang 'dres/ mnyam rjes med/ ris med/ nyin mtshan bar med/ blang dor med/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba blo zad chos zad du la zla ba ni ka dag khregs chod kyi gnas lugs snying po yang dag pa'o// de dpe ji ltar na rgya mtsho'i nang na nyi zla gza' skar shar ba dang 'dra ste/ rgya mtsho'i nang du nyi zla gza' skar thams cad gsal la ma 'dres pa bkra lam mer shar/ shar ba de rgya mtsho la bzang ngan gyi rtog pa med/ dpe des na bdag rgya mtsho lta bu/ phyi tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad rang la 'char ba ste/ nyi zla gza' skar lta bu rgya mtsho la der 'dzin gyi rtog pa med pa de lta bu tshogs drug gi snang ba ci shar yang gsal la ma 'dres der 'dzin gyi rtog pas ma bslad pa zhig dgos pa'o// ces pa 'di phyag mdzod rdo rjes zin bris su btab pa yin 'dug go// sarba mad+ga lam/ 'di zhwa dmar pa'i phyag mdzod skyes mchog zhu ba de red ces mchan du btab 'dug ste/ khrid 'di sngon 'gro'i gral du bka' 'bum nang 'jog rgyu mdzad thog khrid lung yang rgyun ma nyams par de bzhin stabs gcig tu yod 'dug pas sngon 'gro dngos gzhi lhan cig cha tshang ba la dgongs pa yin 'dug pa ltar gnad shin tu che stabs sor bzhag byed rgyu las 'os ma mchis/ gang ltar yang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i zhal rgyun lhad med ngo ma yin ngo shes pa ngo mtshar ba med du mi rung ba zhig 'dug pa'ang kun gyi shes par bya ba'i gnas so/ ༈ /

rtsa gsum 'chi med dril sgrub rgyun bsnyen bzhugs so// na moḥtri mū la ā yurde waḥ bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'chi med dril sgrub las dkyil 'khor bshams bkod dang ma 'brel ba'i rgyun bsnyen kho na'i tshe na thun 'gor/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang chen 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: lnga ldan ye shes rdo rje lug rgyud kyi: zer thag phyogs dang phyogs mtshams steng 'og zug: phyi nang med par 'ja' zer 'od klong 'khyil: dz+nyā na badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes pa'i srung 'khor dang*/ na mo 'chi med lha tshogs thugs rje can: rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i skur: bdag gzhan 'chi med thob bya'i phyir: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ mkha' mnyam skye rga na 'chi yi: sdug bsngal mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir: 'chi med 'ja' lus bsgrub nas kyang: 'gro don byed par sems bskyed do: zhes pas skyabs sems dang*/ hūm̐/ chos rnams spros dang bral ba las: bcos min snying rje'i 'od zer 'phro: gsal dwangs rig pa'i snying po hrī: hrīḥyig gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: rang rig rtsa gsum dril sgrub sku: thugs rje chags pas sku mdog dmar: rtsa zhal dmar po sgeg bzhad chagasaḥ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum: g.yon mthing khro zhal gtum la rngams: dbu skra snum 'bol gyen du 'khyilaḥ dar gyi cod pan nor bus brgyan: spyi gtsug rta gdong hūm̐ sgra ldir: phyag drug dang po mnyam gzhag steng: 'chi med tshe yi bum pas brgyan: bar gnyis pad phreng ut+pal dmar: mtha' gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: rat+na dmar po'i rgyan phreng dang : le brgan na bza' yug gos can: gsang ba ye shes man+dhar: spyi gtsug phag gdong pheṃ sgra ngur: gri thod 'dzin pas mgul nas 'khyud: yab yum gnyis med rol par bzhugs: zhes gtso mchog yab yum las gzhal yas khang 'khor sogs bskyed mi dgos shing*/ rang lhar gsal pa'i ngang nas/

bdag nyid bcom ldan gtso mchog thugs ka ru: nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor de'i nang du: skye med thugs srog bcud phur yi ge hrī: de las lnga ldan 'od zer zer thag ni: rdo rje lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba'i nang : sngags kyi yig 'bru bung ba bcud la 'khor: rang gdangs grag stong 'gyur khug di ri ri: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni pad+ma rā gā bh+ya ā yuḥsid+dhi tshe bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ sham bur/ tshe bsod rgyas dbang du gyur cig puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swa hā: de las sngags phreng thig le zer thag sgreng: lu gu rgyud du ljags kyi pad+mor āḥde la g.yas skor rta gdong zhal nas thon: phyi rol nam mkha' sa chu me rlung dang: nang bcud skye 'gro'i tshe bsod dwangs ma'i bcud: gsang ba sku dang zhing khams mthu byin kun: 'od zer sngags phreng lug rgyud rnam par bsdus: phag gdong zhal nas yum gyi sku dbyibs brgyud: mkha' dbyings gang ba rdo rje'i lam nas rngubs: mas yar spyan drangs tshe yi ga 'ur bstim: tshe yi dngos grub yar ba thams cad bkug: bla tshe nyams gsos brtan g.yo srid bcud kyi: tshe dpal kun bsdus bdud rtsi dwangs mar spar: de yang 'dzag med bde ba chen por bskyil: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog grub gyur: ces mos la bsnyen pa bzla/ thun gyi mthar/ sems kyi sgyu 'phrul tsam du snang ba'i dal: mi dmigs gdod ma'i stong chen ngang du thim: skye ba med las skye ba'i tshul du slar: 'gag med mdangs rtsal glo bur lha ru ldang: sa ma dhi hūm̐ḥ rdzogs rim dang thun mtshams la 'jug /rgyal dbang mchog gi gzigs mor chos rje gling grags bhan can spu sud des shar ris srin rjes 'dra ba bris yod lags/ sngon 'gro'i mjug tu 'di yang bzhag mdzad 'dug pa sngon 'gro khrid gzhung gnyis la phan pa'i cha tshang ba la dgongs pa yin 'dug pa ltar khrid 'di yi mjug tu bkod rgyu byas so/// /
